about: Sainte-Julie is a South Shore city in Montérégie, east of Longueuil along Autoroute 20. It grew from a rural parish into a family-oriented suburban city of parks, schools, and residential neighbourhoods. Woodlots and agricultural edges still frame parts of the municipal boundary. About 30,000 people live in Sainte-Julie.
seoSummary: Family-oriented Montérégie suburb on Autoroute 20, east of Longueuil on the South Shore.
